name: onetouchswitch
description: Local-first, self-hosted UK broadband comparison platform for onetouchswitch.com: local postcode data (OS Code-Point Open / self-hosted postcodes.io), manual address, reviewed local offer catalogue, deterministic cost engine, provider handoff links, session records, private bill OCR queue (Docling via BullMQ).

scripts.build:static: VITE_STATIC=1 vite build && vite build -c vite.engine.config.mjs && node scripts/build-static.mjs
